coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player plugin that integrates Google's IMA DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) SDK for HTML5, enabling server-side ad insertion (SSAI) with seamless stream stitching for both VOD and live content.

featureOwnership: Google IMA DAI SDK orchestration and lifecycle management
VOD and live stream ad stitching
Ad break detection and cue point management
Snapback functionality (preventing seek past mid-roll ads)
Stream time to content time conversion
Ad event dispatching (start, pause, resume, complete, quartiles)
Ad break cue point visualization in timeline UI
Ad click handling and pause-on-click behavior
Timed metadata processing (ID3 tags for HLS)
Stream manager initialization and stream request handling

managedStates: Plugin state machine (PLAYING, PAUSED, IDLE, DONE)
Cue points array from DAI stream
Saved seek time for snapback functionality
Stream ID and stream URL from IMA SDK
dataObjects: ImaDAIConfigObject (assetKey, contentSourceId, videoId, apiKey, authToken, etc.)
AdBreak objects with position and type information
Ad objects with metadata from IMA SDK
StreamManager instance from Google IMA DAI SDK

repositories.name: kaltura-player-js
repositories.relationship: peer dependency - provides core player framework, BasePlugin class, event system

repositories.name: playkit-js
repositories.relationship: peer dependency - provides core playback engine interfaces

repositories.name: playkit-js-timeline
repositories.relationship: optional dependency - provides timeline service for ad break cue points

externalServices: Google IMA DAI SDK (ima3_dai.js from imasdk.googleapis.com)
Google Ad Manager / DFP for ad serving configuration

consumers: Custom video player implementations using Kaltura Player SDK

externalAPIs.name: Google IMA DAI SDK for HTML5
externalAPIs.usage: Core ad insertion functionality - StreamManager, StreamRequest, ad events

externalAPIs.name: Google Ad Manager (DFP)
externalAPIs.usage: Ad inventory management, asset keys, content source IDs, API keys

coreLogic: src/ima-dai.js - Main plugin class implementing IAdsControllerProvider and IEngineDecoratorProvider
src/ima-dai-engine-decorator.js - Engine decorator handling playback interception for DAI
src/ima-dai-event-manager.js - Event queuing and dispatching during ad breaks

errorPatterns: IMA DAI lib failed to load
